<multi_agent_role>You are an agent in a team of agents collaborating to complete a task.

You can spawn sub-agents to handle subtasks, and those sub-agents can spawn their own sub-agents. All agents in the team, including the agents that you can assign tasks to, are equally intelligent and capable, and have access to the same set of tools.

You can use `spawn_agent` to create a new agent, `followup_task` to give an existing agent a new task and trigger a turn, and `send_message` to pass a message to a running agent.
`send_message` calls may be read by a human, so ensure they are legible. Always put proper spaces between words and/or numbers.
Child agents can also spawn their own sub-agents.

When you provide a response in the final channel, that content is immediately delivered back to your parent agent.
In addition, your final answer may be read by a human, so ensure it is legible.

You will receive messages in the analysis channel in the form:
```
Message Type: NEW_TASK | MESSAGE | FINAL_ANSWER
Task name: <recipient>
Sender: <author>
Payload:
<payload text>
```
You may also see them addressed as to=/root/..., which indicates your identity is /root/...

Note that collaboration tools cannot be called from inside `functions.exec`. Call `spawn_agent`, `send_message`, `followup_task`, `wait_agent`, `interrupt_agent`, and `list_agents` only as direct tool calls using the recipient shown in their tool definitions, such as `to=functions.collaboration.spawn_agent`, since they are intentionally absent from the `functions.exec` `tools.*` namespace. Available tools in `functions.exec` are explicitly described with a `tools` namespace in the developer message.

All agents share the same directory. In detail:
- All agents have access to the same container and filesystem as you.
- All agents use the same current working directory.
- As a result, edits made by one agent are immediately visible to all other agents.

When calling `wait_agent`, prefer longer waits (minutes) to avoid busy polling.

There are 4 available concurrency slots, meaning that up to 4 agents can be active at once, including you.

Full-history forks (`fork_turns` omitted or `"all"`) inherit the parent model and reasoning effort and do not accept overrides. Only set `model` or `reasoning_effort` when explicitly requested by the user, applicable `AGENTS.md` instructions, or skill instructions; when doing so, set `fork_turns` to `"none"` or a positive integer string.</multi_agent_role>

null,\\r\\n        reasons: [\\"missed\\"],\\r\\n        sources: [\\"activity_item_responses\\"],\\r\\n        firstAnswer: judged[0].response_text,\\r\\n        latestAnswer: latest.response_text,\\r\\n        correctAnswer: item.credited_answers.join(\\"; \\") || null,\\r\\n        firstMissAt: firstMiss.created_at,\\r\\n        lastActivityAt: latestDate(latest.created_at, assignment.completed_at, assignment.started_at),\\r\\n        reflection: null,\\r\\n        flaggedNote: null,\\r\\n        href: `/review/activity/${encodeURIComponent(assignment.id)}/${item.order}`,\\r\\n      });\\r\\n    }\\r\\n  }\\r\\n  return result.sort((a, b) => b.lastActivityAt.localeCompare(a.lastActivityAt));\\r\\n}\\r\\n\\r\\n/** Each completed standalone section is a separate sitting, even when it uses the same PT question. */\\r\\nexport function buildSectionReviewQueue(rows: SectionHistoryRow[]): ReviewQueueItem[] {\\r\\n  const items: ReviewQueueItem[] = [];\\r\\n  for (const row of rows) {\\r\\n    if (row.mode !== \\"full-section\\" || row.practiceTestRunId || !row.questions.length) continue;\\r\\n    for (const question of row.questions) {\\r\\n      // A blank the student never opened is not a deliberate skip.\\r\\n      if (question.initialAnswer !== UNANSWERED || question.everVisited !== true) continue;\\r\\n      items.push({\\r\\n        key: `section:${row.id}:${question.qid}`,\\r\\n        area: \\"lr\\",\\r\\n        qid: question.qid,\\r\\n        label: `PT${row.pt}–S${row.section}–Q${question.qnum} · Timed section`,\\r\\n        qtype: question.qtype || null,\\r\\n        reasons: [\\"skipped\\"],\\r\\n        sources: [\\"section_history\\"],\\r\\n        firstAnswer: null,\\r\\n        latestAnswer: question.brAnswer && question.brAnswer !== UNANSWERED ? question.brAnswer : null,\\r\\n        correctAnswer: question.correctAnswer || null,\\r\\n        firstMissAt: row.completedAt,\\r\\n        lastActivityAt: row.completedAt,\\r\\n        reflection: null,\\r\\n        flaggedNote: null,\\r\\n        href: `/review/section/${encodeURIComponent(row.id)}/${encodeURIComponent(question.qid)}`,\\r\\n      });\\r\\n    }\\r\\n  }\\r\\n  return items.sort((a, b) => b.lastActivityAt.localeCompare(a.lastActivityAt));\\r\\n}\\r\\nimport { useMemo, useState } from \'react\';\\r\\nimport { Link } from \'react-router-dom\';\\r\\nimport { useFirstAnswerProgress } from \'@/hooks/useFirstAnswerProgress\';\\r\\nimport { useDossier } from \'./StudentDossier\';\\r\\nimport { selectDossierReviewEvidence } from \'./dossierReviewEvidence\';\\r\\n\\r\\nconst PAGE_SIZE = 30;\\r\\n\\r\\nexport default function DossierReview() {\\r\\n  const { studentId, studentName } = useDossier();\\r\\n  const { resolution, ledger, loading, error, refresh } = useFirstAnswerProgress(\'all\', studentId);\\r\\n  const [limit, setLimit] = useState(PAGE_SIZE);\\r\\n  const misses = useMemo(() => selectDossierReviewEvidence(ledger?.answers ?? []), [ledger]);\\r\\n  const missing = ledger?.coverage.missingSources ?? [];\\r\\n\\r\\n  return (\\r\\n    <div className=\\"space-y-4 p-5\\">\\r\\n      <header className=\\"flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3\\">\\r\\n        <div>\\r\\n          <h2 className=\\"text-lg font-semibold text-black\\">Saved answer review</h2>\\r\\n          <p className=\\"mt-1 max-w-2xl text-xs leading-relaxed text-black/55\\">\\r\\n            {studentName || \'This student\'}\'s questions missed on the first saved, graded answer. Reattempts do not remove a miss. This view is evidence for teaching, not a scored practice session.\\r\\n          </p>\\r\\n        </div>\\r\\n        <div className=\\"flex flex-wrap gap-2\\">\\r\\n          <Link to=\\"../work\\" className=\\"inline-flex min-h-11 items-center border border-black/15 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-black/70 hover:bg-white/30\\">Open work</Link>\\r\\n          <Link to=\\"../notes\\" className=\\"inline-flex min-h-11 items-center border border-black/15 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-black/70 hover:bg-white/30\\">Post recap</Link>\\r\\n        </div>\\r\\n      </header>\\r\\n\\r\\n      {loading ? <p role=\\"status\\" className=\\"text-sm text-black/55\\">Loading saved answers…</p>\\r\\n        : resolution.state === \'denied\' ? <p role=\\"alert\\" className=\\"text-sm text-black/55\\">This student\'s saved answers are unavailable to this account.</p>\\r\\n        : error ? (\\r\\n          <div role=\\"alert\\" className=\\"border border-amber-800/20 bg-amber-50/50 p-4 text-sm text-black/70\\">\\r\\n            <p>Saved answers could not be loaded.</p>\\r\\n            <button type=\\"button\\" onClick={() => void refresh()} className=\\"mt-2 inline-flex min-h-11 items-center font-semibold underline\\">Retry</button>\\r\\n          </div>\\r\\n        ) : !ledger || ledger.coverage.includedSources.length === 0 ? (\\r\\n          <p role=\\"alert\\" className=\\"text-sm text-black/55\\">Saved answer sources are unavailable. No review list can be calculated.</p>\\r\\n        ) : (\\r\\n          <>\\r\\n            {missing.length > 0 && (\\r\\n              <p role=\\"status\\" className=\\"border border-amber-800/20 bg-amber-50/50 p-3 text-xs text-black/70\\">\\r\\n                Partial data: {missing.map((item) => item.source.replace(/_/g, \' \')).join(\', \')} could not be loaded. The list below covers available saved sources only.\\r\\n              </p>\\r\\n            )}\\r\\n            <div className=\\"flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 text-xs text-black/60\\">\\r\\n              <strong className=\\"text-black\\">{misses.length} first-answer {misses.length === 1 ? \'miss\' : \'misses\'}</strong>\\r\\n              <span>{misses.filter((item) => item.area === \'LR\').length} LR</span>\\r\\n              <span>{misses.filter((item) => item.area === \'RC\').length} RC</span>\\r\\n            </div>\\r\\n            <p className=\\"text-xs leading-relaxed text-black/60\\">Saved wrong-answer notes, flags, active sessions, and ungraded work are not included here yet. Open the student\'s Work tab to assign a follow-up.</p>\\r\\n            {misses.length === 0 ? (\\r\\n              <p className=\\"border border-black/10 bg-white/20 p-4 text-sm text-black/55\\">No first-answer misses in the available saved sources.</p>\\r\\n            ) : (\\r\\n              <ul className=\\"divide-y divide-black/10 border border-black/10 bg-white/20\\">\\r\\n                {misses.slice(0, limit).map((item) => (\\r\\n                  <li key={item.key} className=\\"flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-2 px-4 py-3 text-xs\\">\\r\\n                    <div className=\\"min-w-0\\">\\r\\n                      <strong className=\\"break-all text-[13px] text-black\\">{item.label}</strong>\\r\\n                      <p className=\\"mt-1 text-black/55\\">{item.area === \'LR\' ? \'Logical Reasoning\' : \'Reading Comprehension\'}{item.topic ? ` · ${item.topic}` : \'\'} · {item.source}</p>\\r\\n                    </div>\\r\\n                    <time className=\\"shrink-0 text-black/60\\" dateTime={item.firstAnsweredAt}>\\r\\n                      {new Intl.DateTimeFormat(undefined, { month: \'short\', day: \'numeric\', year: \'numeric\' }).format(new Date(item.firstAnsweredAt))}\\r\\n                    </time>\\r\\n                  </li>\\r\\n                ))}\\r\\n              </ul>\\r\\n            )}\\r\\n            {misses.length > limit && (\\r\\n              <button type=\\"button\\" onClick={() => setLimit((current) => current + PAGE_SIZE)} className=\\"inline-flex min-h-11 items-center border border-black/15 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-black/70 hover:bg-white/30\\">\\r\\n                Show more ({Math.min(limit, misses.length)} of {misses.length})\\r\\n              </button>\\r\\n            )}\\r\\n          </>\\r\\n        )}\\r\\n    </div>\\r\\n  );\\r\\n}\\r\\n/**\\r\\n * Fire-and-forget logger for Intro to LR per-question attempts.\\r\\n *\\r\\n * Every answer the student submits in the bootcamp\'s InteractiveDrillRunner\\r\\n * is recorded to `public.intro_lr_attempts`, scoped to the signed-in user.\\r\\n * Errors are swallowed (with a console.warn) so a bad network never breaks\\r\\n * the drill UI.\\r\\n */\\r\\n\\r\\nimport { supabase } from \'@/integrations/supabase/client\';\\r\\n\\r\\nexport interface IntroLrAttemptInput {\\r\\n  drillId: string;\\r\\n  questionId: string;\\r\\n  mode: string;\\r\\n  correct: boolean;\\r\\n  selectedAnswer?: string | null;\\r\\n  timeMs?: number | null;\\r\\n}\\r\\n\\r\\n// In-memory de-dupe so re-renders or accidental double-fires don\'t double-log\\r\\n// the same question response within a session.\\r\\nconst seen = new Set<string>();\\r\\n\\r\\nexport function logIntroLrAttempt(input: IntroLrAttemptInput): void {\\r\\n  void (async () => {\\r\\n    try {\\r\\n      const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\\r\\n      if (!user) return;\\r\\n      const dedupeKey = `${user.id}::${input.drillId}::${input.questionId}::${input.correct}::${input.selectedAnswer ?? \'\'}`;\\r\\n      if (seen.has(dedupeKey)) return;\\r\\n      seen.add(dedupeKey);\\r\\n\\r\\n      const { error } = await supabase.from(\'intro_lr_attempts\').insert({\\r\\n        user_id: user.id,\\r\\n        drill_id: input.drillId,\\r\\n        question_id: input.questionId,\\r\\n        mode: input.mode,\\r\\n        selected_answer: input.selectedAnswer ?? null,\\r\\n        correct: input.correct,\\r\\n        time_ms: input.timeMs ?? null,\\r\\n      });\\r\\n      if (error) {\\r\\n        console.warn(\'[intro_lr_attempts] insert failed\', error.message);\\r\\n        seen.delete(dedupeKey);\\r\\n      }\\r\\n    } catch (e) {\\r\\n      console.warn(\'[intro_lr_attempts] log threw\', e);\\r\\n    }\\r\\n  })();\\r\\n}\\r\\n/**\\r\\n * Practice-set resume store for the Intro to LR practice drills.\\r\\n *\\r\\n * A student who starts a practice set and leaves — closes the tab, clicks away\\r\\n * to a lesson, signs out, comes back tomorrow on another machine — must land\\r\\n * back on the question they stopped on, with every answer they already gave\\r\\n * still marked. React state and URL params cannot do that: both die with the\\r\\n * page. So each practice set keeps one durable row per user in the shared\\r\\n * bootcamp_kv persistence (the same layer module_progress uses), written on\\r\\n * every answer and on every question move.\\r\\n *\\r\\n * These are standalone functions rather than a hook because the drill runner\\r\\n * (src/pages/Drill.tsx) lives outside the bootcamp\'s React tree — the same\\r\\n * reason recordPracticeCompletion.ts exists.\\r\\n *\\r\\n * Failure policy: reads degrade to null (a missing resume row must never block\\r\\n * starting a drill). Writes throw so the caller can surface a toast rather than\\r\\n * silently losing a student\'s place.\\r\\n */\\r\\n\\r\\nimport { getPersistence } from \'@/bootcamps/main-conclusion/persistence/factory\';\\r\\nimport { TABLES, PracticeSession, type PracticeSessionAttempt } from \'@/bootcamps/main-conclusion/persistence/records\';\\r\\nimport { now } from \'@/bootcamps/main-conclusion/lib/ids\';\\r\\nimport {\\r\\n  MAIN_CONCLUSION_PRACTICE_POOLS,\\r\\n  type PracticePool,\\r\\n} from \'@/bootcamps/main-conclusion/data/practiceDrillPools\';\\r\\n\\r\\nexport const PRACTICE_SESSION_DATA_VERSION = 2;\\r\\n\\r\\nconst PT118_S1_ANSWERS: Record<number, string> = {\\r\\n  1: \'A\', 2: \'C\', 3: \'B\', 4: \'C\', 6: \'D\', 7: \'B\', 8: \'A\',\\r\\n  9: \'E\', 10: \'A\', 11: \'C\', 12: \'C\', 13: \'E\', 14: \'E\',\\r\\n  15: \'E\', 16: \'C\', 17: \'B\', 18: \'D\', 19: \'A\', 20: \'D\',\\r\\n  21: \'A\', 22: \'E\', 23: \'C\', 24: \'B\', 25: \'C\', 26: \'E\',\\r\\n};\\r\\n\\r\\nfunction migratePt118Qid(qid: string): string | null {\\r\\n  const match = /^PT118-S([1234])-Q(\\\\d+)$/.exec(qid);\\r\\n  if (!match) return qid;\\r\\n  const section = Number(match[1]);\\r\\n  const number = Number(match[2]);\\r\\n  if (section === 3 && number === 22) return null;\\r\\n  if (section === 1 && number >= 5 && number <= 25) return `PT118-S1-Q${number + 1}`;\\r\\n  return qid;\\r\\n}\\r\\n\\r\\nfunction pt118CorrectAnswer(qid: string): string | undefined {\\r\\n  const match = /^PT118-S([12])-Q(\\\\d+)$/.exec(qid);\\r\\n  if (!match) return undefined;\\r\\n  const section = Number(match[1]);\\r\\n  const number = Number(match[2]);\\r\\n  if (section === 1) return PT118_S1_ANSWERS[number];\\r\\n  if (section === 2) return ({ 1: \'D\', 5: \'A\' } as Record<number, string>)[number];\\r\\n  return undefined;\\r\\n}\\r\\n\\r\\n/** Remap pre-repair PT118 resume IDs once, preserving the student\'s place by content. */\\r\\nexport function migratePracticeSession(row: PracticeSession): PracticeSession {\\r\\n  if ((row.data_version ?? 0) >= PRACTICE_SESSION_DATA_VERSION) return row;\\r\\n  // These namespaces are written by the Drill runner, whose displayed LR\\r\\n  // content comes from the local JSON QuestionBank. An unknown producer may\\r\\n  // have used the already-canonical catalog, so its IDs are not safe to shift.\\r\\n  if (!row.pool_slug.startsWith(\'drill::\') && !row.pool_slug.startsWith(\'guided::\')) return row;\\r\\n  const oldCurrent = row.question_queue[row.current_index];\\r\\n  const mappedCurrent = oldCurrent ? migratePt118Qid(oldCurrent) : null;\\r\\n  const seen = new Set<string>();\\r\\n  const questionQueue = row.question_queue.flatMap((qid) => {\\r\\n    const mapped = migratePt118Qid(qid);\\r\\n    if (!mapped || seen.has(mapped)) return [];\\r\\n    seen.add(mapped);\\r\\n    return [mapped];\\r\\n  });\\r\\n  const seenAttempts = new Set<string>();\\r\\n  const attempts = row.attempts.flatMap((attempt) => {\\r\\n    const qid = migratePt118Qid(attempt.qid);\\r\\n    if (!qid || seenAttempts.has(qid)) return [];\\r\\n    seenAttempts.add(qid);\\r\\n    const answer = pt118CorrectAnswer(qid);\\r\\n    return [{ ...attempt, qid, correct: answer ? attempt.selected_answer === answer : attempt.correct }];\\r\\n  });\\r\\n  const currentIndex = mappedCurrent && questionQueue.includes(mappedCurrent)\\r\\n    ? questionQueue.indexOf(mappedCurrent)\\r\\n    : Math.min(row.current_index, Math.max(questionQueue.length - 1, 0));\\r\\n  const regulationAnsweredQids = row.regulation_answered_qids && [\\r\\n    ...new Set(row.regulation_answered_qids.map(migratePt118Qid).filter((qid): qid is string => !!qid)),\\r\\n  ];\\r\\n  return PracticeSession.parse({\\r\\n    ...row,\\r\\n    data_version: PRACTICE_SESSION_DATA_VERSION,\\r\\n    question_queue: questionQueue,\\r\\n    current_index: currentIndex,\\r\\n    attempts,\\r\\n    regulation_answered_qids: regulationAnsweredQids,\\r\\n  });\\r\\n}\\r\\n\\r\\n/**\\r\\n * Deterministic per-user, per-pool record id, so every read and write lands on\\r\\n * the same row without a lookup. Mirrors progressIdFor\'s FNV-1a approach but\\r\\n * hashes user + slug together.\\r\\n */\\r\\nexport function practiceSessionIdFor(userId: string, poolSlug: string): string {\\r\\n  const input = `${userId}::${poolSlug}`;\\r\\n  let h = 0x811c9dc5;\\r\\n  for (let i = 0; i < input.length; i++) {\\r\\n    h ^= input.charCodeAt(i);\\r\\n    h = Math.imul(h, 0x01000193);\\r\\n  }\\r\\n  let h2 = 0x811c9dc5;\\r\\n  for (let i = input.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {\\r\\n    h2 ^= input.charCodeAt(i);\\r\\n    h2 = Math.imul(h2, 0x01000193);\\r\\n  }\\r\\n  const hex = (h >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, \'0\');\\r\\n  const hex2 = (h2 >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, \'0\');\\r\\n  return `00000000-0000-4000-8000-${hex}${hex2.slice(0, 4)}`;\\r\\n}\\r\\n\\r\\n/**\\r\\n * One writer per row at a time.\\r\\n *\\r\\n * Both writers below read the row and then write it, with an await in between.\\r\\n * The drill runner fires a snapshot on every answer and a completion at the\\r\\n * end, and nothing stopped a snapshot that had already read the row from\\r\\n * writing it AFTER the completion had — which put a finished section back to\\r\\n * in_progress. Chaining each row\'s writes behind the previous one keeps them\\r\\n * in the order they were asked for. Writes to different rows still overlap.\\r\\n */\\r\\nconst rowChains = new Map<string, Promise<unknown>>();\\r\\n\\r\\nasync function withRow<T>(id: string, fn: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {\\r\\n  const previous = rowChains.get(id) ?? Promise.resolve();\\r\\n  const run = previous.then(fn, fn);\\r\\n  rowChains.set(id, run.catch(() => undefined));\\r\\n  try {\\r\\n    return await run;\\r\\n  } finally {\\r\\n    if (rowChains.get(id) === run) rowChains.delete(id);\\r\\n  }\\r\\n}\\r\\n\\r\\nexport interface PracticeSessionSnapshot {\\r\\n  questionQueue: string[];\\r\\n  currentIndex: number;\\r\\n  attempts: PracticeSessionAttempt[];\\r\\n  /** Section clock already spent, for the surfaces that run one. */\\r\\n  elapsedMs?: number;\\r\\n  timerMode?: \'35\' | \'52.5\' | \'70\' | \'custom\' | \'unlimited\';\\r\\n  timerCustomMinutes?: number;\\r\\n  /** Answers that were already down when the clock ran out, if it did. */\\r\\n  regulationAnsweredQids?: string[];\\r\\n}\\r\\n\\r\\n/**\\r\\n * Read the stored session for one pool. Returns null when there is nothing to\\r\\n * resume, when the row is corrupt, or when persistence is unavailable — all of\\r\\n * which mean \\"start fresh\\", never \\"block the student\\".\\r\\n * Official section recovery opts into readOnly so a migration cannot publish\\r\\n * device state before its active-device and account-save gates acknowledge it.\\r\\n */\\r\\nexport async function loadPracticeSession(\\r\\n  userId: string,\\r\\n  poolSlug: string,\\r\\n  options: { readOnly?: boolean } = {},\\r\\n): Promise<PracticeSession | null> {\\r\\n  if (!userId || !poolSlug) return null;\\r\\n  try {\\r\\n    const persist = getPersistence(userId);\\r\\n    // Wait for cloud hydration first, otherwise a cold load on a second device\\r\\n    // reports \\"nothing to resume\\" while the row is still in flight.\\r\\n    await persist.ready();\\r\\n    const raw = await persist.get<unknown>(TABLES.practice_sessions, practiceSessionIdFor(userId, poolSlug));\\r\\n    if (!raw) return null;\\r\\n    const parsed = PracticeSession.safeParse(raw);\\r\\n    if (!parsed.success) {\\r\\n      console.warn(\'[practice-session] stored row failed validation, ignoring\', {\\r\\n        poolSlug,\\r\\n        issues: parsed.error.issues,\\r\\n      });\\r\\n      return null;\\r\\n    }\\r\\n    const migrated = migratePracticeSession(parsed.data);\\r\\n    if (migrated !== parsed.data && !options.readOnly) {\\r\\n      try {\\r\\n        await persist.set(TABLES.practice_sessions, migrated.id, migrated);\\r\\n      } catch (error) {\\r\\n        // A sync failure must not hide an otherwise usable local resume row.\\r\\n        console.warn(\'[practice-session] migration write failed\', { poolSlug, error });\\r\\n      }\\r\\n    }\\r\\n    return migrated;\\r\\n  } catch (e) {\\r\\n    console.warn(\'[practice-session] load failed, starting fresh\', { poolSlug, error: e });\\r\\n    return null;\\r\\n  }\\r\\n}\\r\\n\\r\\n/** Read the stored session for every practice pool, for the index UI. */\\r\\nexport async function loadAllPracticeSessions(\\r\\n  userId: string,\\r\\n): Promise<Record<string, PracticeSession>> {\\r\\n  const slugs = Object.keys(MAIN_CONCLUSION_PRACTICE_POOLS);\\r\\n  const rows = await Promise.all(slugs.map((slug) => loadPracticeSession(userId, slug)));\\r\\n  const out: Record<string, PracticeSession> = {};\\r\\n  rows.forEach((row, i) => {\\r\\n    if (row) out[slugs[i]] = row;\\r\\n  });\\r\\n  return out;\\r\\n}\\r\\n\\r\\n/**\\r\\n * Write the student\'s current place in a practice set. A caller that must not write over a finished run —\\r\\n * a homework assignment, whose row is that one sitting — stops calling before\\r\\n * it gets here (see genericFinalizedRef in Drill.tsx).\\r\\n */\\r\\nexport async function savePracticeSessionSnapshot(\\r\\n  userId: string,\\r\\n  pool: Pick<PracticePool, \'slug\' | \'completionId\'>,\\r\\n  snapshot: PracticeSessionSnapshot,\\r\\n): Promise<void> {\\r\\n  if (!userId || !pool?.slug) return;\\r\\n  if (snapshot.questionQueue.length === 0) return;\\r\\n\\r\\n  const id = practiceSessionIdFor(userId, pool.slug);\\r\\n  await withRow(id, async () => {\\r\\n    const persist = getPersistence(userId);\\r\\n    const existing = await loadPracticeSession(userId, pool.slug);\\r\\n\\r\\n    const record = PracticeSession.parse({\\r\\n      id,\\r\\n      user_id: userId,\\r\\n      pool_slug: pool.slug,\\r\\n      completion_id: pool.completionId,\\r\\n      data_version: PRACTICE_SESSION_DATA_VERSION,\\r\\n      question_queue: snapshot.questionQueue,\\r\\n      current_index: Math.min(\\r\\n        Math.max(snapshot.currentIndex, 0),\\r\\n        Math.max(snapshot.questionQueue.length - 1, 0),\\r\\n      ),\\r\\n      attempts: snapshot.attempts,\\r\\n      status: \'in_progress\',\\r\\n      // Never hand back time already spent: a snapshot with no clock keeps\\r\\n      // whatever the row already knew rather than clearing it.\\r\\n      elapsed_ms: snapshot.elapsedMs ?? existing?.elapsed_ms,\\r\\n      timer_mode: snapshot.timerMode ?? existing?.timer_mode,\\r\\n      timer_custom_minutes: snapshot.timerCustomMinutes ?? existing?.timer_custom_minutes,\\r\\n      regulation_answered_qids:\\r\\n        snapshot.regulationAnsweredQids ?? existing?.regulation_answered_qids,\\r\\n      started_at: existing?.started_at ?? now(),\\r\\n      updated_at: now(),\\r\\n    });\\r\\n\\r\\n    await persist.set(TABLES.practice_sessions, id, record);\\r\\n  });\\r\\n}\\r\\n\\r\\n/**\\r\\n * Mark the set finished. Recommended complete #170 batch:

1. **Hard Sentences saved misses, no backend migration required.**
   - Extend `src/components/review/introLrReviewSource.ts` using `content/hard-sentences-drill.source.ts` for existing cluster attempts.
   - Add calibration adapter reading owner-filtered `bootcamp_kv` namespace `calibration_attempts`, resolving `content/m5-capstone.source.ts`.
   - Add read-only exact saved-attempt detail, source-specific warnings/retry and Review queue integration.
   - Preserve repeated attempts and namespace/key identity. Capstone currently creates different UUIDs for envelope key and payload `id`; existing records must be fetched by envelope key.

2. **Current native labs need actual durable logging first.**
   - `MainConclusionLab` → `MainConclusionReplicaTemplate`
   - `StructureClassification` → `RebuttalVsFirstReplicaTemplate`
   - `ConclusionTypeLab`
   - These hold answers in React state and save only completion. Their misses cannot be recovered by adding a read adapter.
   - Add acknowledged, stable per-sitting/per-response writes, owner-scoped source registry and read-only review details. Existing `intro_lr_attempts` can store individual responses, but its current fire-and-forget logger deduplicates repeated identical answers for the whole page lifetime and cannot establish reliable sitting identity.
   - Old `FirstSentenceVsRebuttalLab` checkpoint blobs are a different implementation, not proof of current native coverage.

3. **Durable teacher-selected review requires a real source contract.**
   - `ReviewReason` currently contains only missed/flagged/skipped.
   - `DossierReview.tsx` lists first-answer misses without exact question links, notes, flags or selection controls.
   - `wajNotesService.ts` filters reads/writes to authenticated actor `user_id`; reusing it for student records would conflate teacher and student ownership.
   - Add teacher review records with immutable actor, subject, source type, source record/item key, instruction and lifecycle. Backend must validate teacher access and source ownership, restrict student mutations to their lifecycle fields, and preserve selections independently of answer/grade history.
   - Share read-only selected-student source adapters between teacher Review and student teacher-selected filter. Opening a teacher view must never launch scored student practice.

The coverage document explicitly leaves these sources open. No files changed and no backend writes performed in this investigation.

; offset += 500) {\n+    const { data, error } = await supabase.from('intro_lr_attempts').select('*').eq('user_id', userId)\n+      .eq('drill_id', HS_DRILL_ID).eq('correct', false).order('id').range(offset, offset + 499);\n+    if (error) throw error;\n+    if (!Array.isArray(data)) throw new Error('Hard Sentences cluster source returned an invalid response.');\n+    for (const raw of data) { const attempt = parseHardSentencesCluster(raw, userId); in src/pages/IntroToLrBootcamp.tsx — if\\r\\n * useAuth returns null user, that page redirects to /auth before this hook runs.\\r\\n *\\r\\n * The bootcamp\'s User Zod schema stays (used by other modules); we project the\\r\\n * Supabase user into that shape.\\r\\n */\\r\\n\\r\\nimport { useEffect, useState } from \'react\';\\r\\nimport { useAuth } from \'@/contexts/AuthContext\';\\r\\nimport { getPersistence } from \'@/bootcamps/main-conclusion/persistence/factory\';\\r\\nimport { TABLES, User } from \'@/bootcamps/main-conclusion/persistence/records\';\\r\\nimport { now } from \'@/bootcamps/main-conclusion/lib/ids\';\\r\\n\\r\\n// Legacy export (kept for any local tests that still imported the constant).\\r\\n// In LSAT U the real Supabase user.id is authoritative.\\r\\nexport const STUB_USER_ID_EXPORT = \'00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001\';\\r\\n\\r\\nexport function useUser(): User | null {\\r\\n  const { user: authUser } = useAuth();\\r\\n  const [user, setUser] = useState<User | null>(null);\\r\\n\\r\\n  useEffect(() => {\\r\\n    if (!authUser) {\\r\\n      setUser(null);\\r\\n      return;\\r\\n    }\\r\\n    let cancelled = false;\\r\\n    (async () => {\\r\\n      const persist = getPersistence(authUser.id);\\r\\n      let existing = await persist.get<User>(TABLES.users, authUser.id);\\r\\n      if (!existing) {\\r\\n        existing = User.parse({\\r\\n          id: authUser.id,\\r\\n          name:\\r\\n            (authUser.user_metadata && (authUser.user_metadata.display_name as string)) ||\\r\\n            (authUser.user_metadata && (authUser.user_metadata.username as string)) ||\\r\\n            authUser.email ||\\r\\n            \'Student\',\\r\\n          started_at: now(),\\r\\n          last_seen: now(),\\r\\n          settings: {},\\r\\n        });\\r\\n        await persist.set(TABLES.users, authUser.id, existing);\\r\\n      } else {\\r\\n        existing = { ...existing, last_seen: now() };\\r\\n        await persist.set(TABLES.users, authUser.id, existing);\\r\\n      }\\r\\n      if (!cancelled) setUser(existing);\\r\\n    })();\\r\\n    return () => {\\r\\n      cancelled = ## assistant

Native Review batch implemented:

- Three current labs save each response before feedback or advancement.
- Distinct sitting and response UUIDs retain retakes; retry reconciles the same response.
- Failures preserve the selected answer and offer Retry.
- Completion waits for saved responses and acknowledged module progress.
- Account changes and unmounts cannot acknowledge an old response in another account’s UI.
- Exact saved Review details and named source warnings are integrated.

Verification: 24 distinct focused tests passed, final typecheck passed, ESLint passed, diff check passed.

No backend migration is needed for this bounded batch. Actual signed-in browser verification and release remain with root. Full reload/resume and server-trusted grading are not claimed.

PUBLIC_COMMAND_HANDLERS\\r\\ncreate function public.timed_section_validate_command_v1(p_command jsonb,p_creation boolean) returns void\\r\\nlanguage plpgsql set search_path=pg_catalog,public as $$\\r\\nbegin\\r\\n  perform public.timed_pt_check_keys_v1(p_command,array[\'workKind\',\'workId\',\'commandId\',\'deviceId\',\'expectedRevision\',\'writerEpoch\',\'operation\',\'payload\']);\\r\\n  if p_command->>\'workKind\' is distinct from \'standalone-section\'\\r\\n    or jsonb_typeof(p_command->\'workId\') is distinct from \'string\'\\r\\n    or jsonb_typeof(p_command->\'commandId\') is distinct from \'string\'\\r\\n    or jsonb_typeof(p_command->\'deviceId\') is distinct from \'string\'\\r\\n    or coalesce(length(p_command->>\'deviceId\'),0) not between 1 and 128\\r\\n    or jsonb_typeof(p_command->\'expectedRevision\') is distinct from \'number\' or p_command->>\'expectedRevision\' !~ \'^[0-9]+$\'\\r\\n    or jsonb_typeof(p_command->\'writerEpoch\') is distinct from \'number\' or p_command->>\'writerEpoch\' !~ \'^[0-9]+$\'\\r\\n    or jsonb_typeof(p_command->\'payload\') is distinct from \'object\'\\r\\n    or (p_creation and (p_command->>\'operation\' is distinct from \'create\' or p_command->>\'expectedRevision\'<>\'0\' or p_command->>\'writerEpoch\'<>\'0\'))\\r\\n    or (not p_creation and coalesce(p_command->>\'operation\',\'\') not in (\'claim\',\'start\',\'checkpoint\',\'heartbeat\',\'pause\',\'resume\',\'close\',\'abandon\')) then\\r\\n    raise exception \'Invalid standalone command envelope\' using errcode=\'PT422\'; end if;\\r\\n  if (p_command->>\'workId\')::uuid is null or (p_command->>\'commandId\')::uuid is null then\\r\\n    raise exception \'Sitting and command UUIDs required\' using errcode=\'PT422\'; end if;\\r\\nend $$;\\r\\n\\r\\ncreate or replace function public.timed_section_capability_v1() returns jsonb\\r\\nlanguage sql security definer set search_path=pg_catalog,public as $$\\r\\n  select jsonb_build_object(\'contractVersion\',1,\'workKind\',\'standalone-section\',\'enabled\',\\r\\n    coalesce((select enabled from public.timed_section_configuration_v1 where singleton),false),\\r\\n    \'operations\',jsonb_build_array(\'read\',\'create\',\'claim\',\'start\',\'checkpoint\',\'heartbeat\',\'pause\',\'resume\',\'close\',\'abandon\'),\\r\\n    \'sources\',jsonb_build_array(\'manual-canonical\'),\'stage\',\'writer-installed\');\\r\\n$$;\\r\\n\\r\\ncreate function public.create_timed_section_v1(p_command jsonb) returns jsonb\\r\\nlanguage plpgsql security definer set search_path=pg_catalog,public as $$\\r\\n<<create_section>>\\r\\ndeclare actor uuid:=public.timed_pt_actor_v1(); r public.timed_section_sittings_v1; rec public.timed_section_receipts_v1;\\r\\n  c public.timed_section_configuration_v1; payload jsonb:=p_command->\'payload\'; frozen jsonb; id uuid; cid uuid;\\r\\n  source_kind text; pt integer; section integer; pace text; seconds integer; at_time timestamptz;\\r\\nbegin\\r\\n  if actor is null then raise exception \'Authentication required\' using errcode=\'PT401\'; end if;\\r\\n  perform public.timed_section_validate_command_v1(p_command,true);\\r\\n  perform public.timed_pt_check_keys_v1(payload,array[\'kind\',\'pt\',\'section\',\'pace\']);\\r\\n  id:=(p_command->>\'workId\')::uuid; cid:=(p_command->>\'commandId\')::uuid;\\r\\n  -- Serialize a missing sitting and exact creation receipt before row existence.\\r\\n  perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(\'timed-section-create:\'||actor::text||\':\'||id::text,0));\\r\\n  select * into r from public.timed_section_sittings_v1 where timed_section_sittings_v1.id=create_section.id and owner_id=actor for update;\\r\\n  if found then\\r\\n    select * into rec from public.timed_section_receipts_v1 where sitting_id=r.id and owner_id=actor and command_id=cid;\\r\\n    if found and rec.canonical_command=p_command then return public.timed_section_response_v1(r,rec,true); end if;\\r\\n    if found then raise exception \'Changed command replay\' using errcode=\'PT412\'; end if;\\r\\n    raise exception \'Sitting identity already exists\' using errcode=\'PT409\';\\r\\n  end if;\\r\\n  select * into c from public.timed_section_configuration_v1 where singleton for share;\\r\\n  if not coalesce(c.enabled,false) then raise exception \'Standalone timed writer inactive\' using errcode=\'PT503\'; end if;\\r\\n  perform public.timed_section_require_access_v1(actor);\\r\\n  if jsonb_typeof(payload->\'kind\') is distinct from \'string\' or payload->>\'kind\' not in (\'lr\',\'rc\')\\r\\n    or jsonb_typeof(payload->\'pt\') is distinct from \'number\' or payload->>\'pt\' !~ \'^[1-9][0-9]*$\'\\r\\n    or jsonb_typeof(payload->\'section\') is distinct from \'number\' or payload->>\'section\' !~ \'^[1-9][0-9]*$\'\\r\\n    or jsonb_typeof(payload->\'pace\') is distinct from \'string\' or payload->>\'pace\' not in (\'standard\',\'time-and-a-half\',\'double-time\',\'untimed\') then\\r\\n    raise exception \'Canonical section and pace required\' using errcode=\'PT422\'; end if;\\r\\n  pt:=(payload->>\'pt\')::integer; section:=(payload->>\'section\')::integer; pace:=payload->>\'pace\';\\r\\n  source_kind:=payload->>\'kind\';\\r\\n  select leg into frozen from public.timed_content_manifests_v1 m,lateral jsonb_array_elements(m.blueprint->\'legs\') leg\\r\\n    where m.manifest_sha256=c.manifest_sha256 and m.pt=create_section.pt\\r\\n      and leg->>\'kind\'=source_kind and (leg->>\'section\')::integer=create_section.section;\\r\\n  if frozen is null then raise exception \'Canonical section unavailable in selected catalog\' using errcode=\'PT422\'; end if;\\r\\n  seconds:=case pace when \'standard\' then 2100 when \'time-and-a-half\' then 3150 when \'double-time\' then 4200 else null end;\\r\\n  at_time:=clock_timestamp();\\r\\n  insert into public.timed_section_sittings_v1(id,owner_id,kind,source_kind,source_key,pt,section,manifest_sha256,frozen_source,frozen_qids,\\r\\n    pace,budget_ms,lease_ms,device_id,created_at,updated_at)\\r\\n    values(id,actor,source_kind,\'manual-canonical\',source_kind||\'::pt\'||pt::text||\'-s\'||section::text,pt,section,c.manifest_sha256,frozen,\\r\\n      array(select jsonb_array_elements_text(frozen->\'qids\')),pace,seconds::bigint*1000,c.lease_ms,p_command->>\'deviceId\',at_time,at_time) returning * into r;\\r\\n  insert into public.timed_section_receipts_v1(owner_id,sitting_id,command_id,canonical_command,committed_revision,result)\\r\\n    values(actor,r.id,cid,p_command,r.revision,jsonb_build_object(\'operation\',\'create\')) returning * into rec;\\r\\n  return public.timed_section_response_v1(r,rec,false);\\r\\nexception when unique_violation then raise exception \'An active sitting already owns this canonical source\' using errcode=\'PT409\';\\r\\nend $$;\\r\\n\\r\\ncreate function public.commit_timed_section_v1(p_command jsonb) returns jsonb\\r\\nlanguage plpgsql security definer set search_path=pg_catalog,public as $$\\r\\ndeclare actor uuid:=public.timed_pt_actor_v1(); r public.timed_section_sittings_v1; rec public.timed_section_receipts_v1;\\r\\n  cid uuid; op text:=p_command->>\'operation\'; payload jsonb:=p_command->\'payload\'; config public.timed_section_configuration_v1;\\r\\n  at_time timestamptz; settled bigint; record_id text; source_key text; rc_id uuid; outcome jsonb;\\r\\nbegin\\r\\n  if actor is null then raise exception \'Authentication required\' using errcode=\'PT401\'; end if;\\r\\n  perform public.timed_section_validate_command_v1(p_command,false);\\r\\n  cid:=(p_command->>\'commandId\')::uuid;\\r\\n  select * into r from public.timed_section_sittings_v1 where id=(p_command->>\'workId\')::uuid and owner_id=actor for update;\\r\\n  if not found then raise exception \'Owned standalone sitting unavailable\' using errcode=\'PT401\'; end if;\\r\\n  select * into rec from public.timed_section_receipts_v1 where owner_id=actor and sitting_id=r.id and command_id=cid;\\r\\n  if found then\\r\\n    if rec.canonical_command<>p_command then raise exception \'Changed command replay\' using errcode=\'PT412\'; end if;\\r\\n    return public.timed_section_response_v1(r,rec,true);\\r\\n  end if;\\r\\n  select * into config from public.timed_section_configuration_v1 where singleton for share;\\r\\n  if not coalesce(config.enabled,false) then raise exception \'Standalone timed writer inactive\' using errcode=\'PT503\'; end if;\\r\\n  if r.revision<>(p_command->>\'expectedRevision\')::bigint or r.writer_epoch<>(p_command->>\'writerEpoch\')::bigint then\\r\\n    raise exception \'Standalone revision or epoch conflict\' using errcode=\'PT409\',detail=jsonb_build_object(\'sitting\',to_jsonb(r))::text; end if;\\r\\n  if r.phase in (\'complete\',\'abandoned\') then raise exception \'Terminal section retained\' using errcode=\'PT409\'; end if;\\r\\n  perform public.timed_section_require_access_v1(actor);\\r\\n  at_time:=clock_timestamp(); settled:=r.elapsed_ms;\\r\\n  if r.phase=\'running\' then settled:=settled+greatest(0,floor(extract(epoch from(least(at_time,r.lease_expires_at)-r.clock_anchor_at))*1000))::bigint; end if;\\r\\n  if op<>\'claim\' and r.device_id<>p_command->>\'deviceId\' then\\r\\n    raise exception \'Another device owns this section\' using errcode=\'PT409\',detail=jsonb_build_object(\'sitting\',to_jsonb(r))::text; end if;\\r\\n  if op<>\'claim\' and r.phase=\'running\' and at_time>r.lease_expires_at then\\r\\n    raise exception \'Section lease expired; explicit claim required\' using errcode=\'PT410\',detail=jsonb_build_object(\'sitting\',to_jsonb(r))::text; end if;\\r\\n  r.elapsed_ms:=settled; outcome:=jsonb_build_object(\'operation\',op);\\r\\n  if op not in (\'checkpoint\',\'close\') then perform public.timed_pt_check_keys_v1(payload,array[]::text[]); end if;\\r\\n  if op=\'claim\' then\\r\\n    if r.device_id<>p_command->>\'deviceId\' and r.phase=\'running\' and at_time<r.lease_expires_at then\\r\\n      raise exception \'A live section lease belongs to another device\' using errcode=\'PT409\'; end if;\\r\\n    r.device_id:=p_command->>\'deviceId\'; r.writer_epoch:=r.writer_epoch+1;\\r\\n    if r.phase=\'running\' then r.phase:=\'paused\'; end if;\\r\\n  elsif op=\'start\' then\\r\\n    if r.phase<>\'ready\' then raise exception \'Section already started\' using errcode=\'PT409\'; end if;\\r\\n    source_key:=\'drill::timed-section::\'||r.id::text; record_id:=\'timed-section::\'||r.id::text;\\r\\n    if r.kind=\'lr\' then\\r\\n      insert into public.timed_section_source_bindings_v1(sitting_id,owner_id,kind,namespace,record_id) values(r.id,actor,\'lr\',\'practice_sessions\',record_id);\\r\\n      insert into public.bootcamp_kv(user_id,table_name,record_id,data) values(actor,\'practice_sessions\',record_id,\\r\\n        jsonb_build_object(\'id\',record_id,\'user_id\',actor,\'pool_slug\',source_key,\'completion_id\',source_key,\'data_version\',2,\'question_queue\',to_jsonb(r.frozen_qids),\\r\\n        \'current_index\',0,\'attempts\',\'[]\'::jsonb,\'status\',\'in_progress\',\'elapsed_ms\',0,\'timer_mode\',case when r.budget_ms is null then \'unlimited\' else \'custom\' end,\\r\\n        \'timer_custom_minutes\',r.budget_ms/60000.0,\'started_at\',at_time,\'updated_at\',at_time));\\r\\n    else\\r\\n      insert into public.rc_drill_sessions(user_id,config,passage_ids,timed_section_sitting_id)\\r\\n        values(actor,jsonb_build_object(\'timedSectionSittingId\',r.id,\'clockElapsedSeconds\',0,\'currentQuestionIndex\',0,\'lastActiveAt\',at_time,\\r\\n          \'timerSeconds\',r.budget_ms/1000,\'mode\',\'section\',\'source\',\'manual\',\'reveal\',\'end_of_set\'),\\r\\n          array(select jsonb_array_elements_text(r.frozen_source->\'passageIds\')::integer),r.id) returning id into rc_id;\\r\\n      insert into public.timed_section_source_bindings_v1(sitting_id,owner_id,kind,rc_session_id) values(r.id,actor,\'rc\',rc_id);\\r\\n    end if;\\r\\n    r.phase:=\'running\';\\r\\n  elsif op=\'checkpoint\' then\\r\\n    if r.phase<>\'running\' then raise exception \'Checkpoint requires running section\' using errcode=\'PT409\'; end if;\\r\\n    perform public.timed_section_save_checkpoint_v1(r,payload,at_time);\\r\\n    r.current_index:=(payload->>\'currentIndex\')::integer;\\r\\n    r.snapshot:=payload;\\r\\n  elsif op=\'heartbeat\' then\\r\\n    if r.phase<>\'running\' then raise exception \'Heartbeat requires running section\' using errcode=\'PT409\'; end if;\\r\\n  elsif op=\'pause\' then\\r\\n    if r.phase<>\'running\' then raise exception \'Section clock is not running\' using errcode=\'PT409\'; end if;\\r\\n    r.phase:=\'paused\';\\r\\n  elsif op=\'resume\' then\\r\\n    if r.phase<>\'paused\' then raise exception \'Section clock is not paused\' using errcode=\'PT409\'; end if;\\r\\n    r.phase:=\'running\';\\r\\n  elsif op=\'close\' then\\r\\n    if r.phase not in (\'running\',\'paused\') then raise exception \'Section cannot close before starting\' using errcode=\'PT409\'; end if;\\r\\n    r.result:=public.timed_section_close_v1(r,payload,at_time); outcome:=outcome||r.result;\\r\\n    r.phase:=\'complete\'; user_id=actor and status=\'in_progress\';\\r\\n  end if;\\r\\n  r.clock_anchor_at:=case when r.phase=\'running\' then at_time else null end;\\r\\n  r.lease_expires_at:=case when r.phase=\'running\' then at_time+r.lease_ms*interval \'1 millisecond\' else null end;\\r\\n  r.revision:=r.revision+1; r.updated_at:=at_time;\\r\\n  update public.timed_section_sittings_v1 set phase=r.phase,revision=r.revision,writer_epoch=r.writer_epoch,device_id=r.device_id,elapsed_ms=r.elapsed_ms,\\r\\n    clock_anchor_at=r.clock_anchor_at,lease_expires_at=r.lease_expires_at,current_index=r.current_index,snapshot=r.snapshot,result=r.result,\\r\\n    completed_at=r.completed_at,updated_at=r.updated_at where id=r.id returning * into r;\\r\\n  insert into public.timed_section_receipts_v1(owner_id,sitting_id,command_id,canonical_command,committed_revision,result)\\r\\n    values(actor,r.id,cid,p_command,r.revision,outcome) returning * into rec;\\r\\n  return public.timed_section_response_v1(r,rec,false);\\r\\nend $$;\\r\\n\\r\\ncreate function public.timed_section_sittings_v1; rec public.timed_section_receipts_v1;\\r\\nbegin\\r\\n  if actor is null then raise exception \'Authentication required\' using errcode=\'PT401\'; end if;\\r\\n $$;\\r\\n\\r\\ncreate temporary table timed_section_bootstrap_membership_v1 on commit drop as\\r\\n  select current_user::text migration_role,m.admin_option,m.set_option,m.inherit_option\\r\\n rolname=current_user);\\r\\ndo $$ declare state record; begin\\r\\n  select * into state from timed_section_bootstrap_membership_v1;\\r\\n  if not A newer local\\r\\n *     practice session is preserved. Official LR sections wait for the\\r\\n *     runner\'s guarded account save; other sessions are queued for sync.\\r\\n *   - Blobs (audio) stay local only.\\r\\n */\\r\\n\\r\\nimport type { Persistence, PersistenceTx } from \'./Persistence\';\\r\\nimport { V1Persistence } from \'./V1Persistence\';\\r\\nimport { LocalStoragePersistence } from \'./LocalStoragePersistence\';\\r\\nimport { IndexedDBPersistence } from \'./IndexedDBPersistence\';\\r\\nimport { supabase } from \'@/integrations/supabase/client\';\\r\\n\\r\\nconst FLUSH_DEBOUNCE_MS = 800;\\r\\n\\r\\n/** Official LR sections use the runner\'s acknowledged save and PT lease gate. */\\r\\nfunction ownsAccountSave(table: string, record: unknown): boolean {\\r\\n  if (table !== \'practice_sessions\' || !record || typeof record !== \'object\') return false;\\r\\n  const slug = (record as { pool_slug?: unknown }).pool_slug;\\r\\n  return typeof slug === \'string\' &&\\r\\n    (slug.startsWith(\'drill::section::\') || slug.startsWith(\'drill::practice-test::\'));\\r\\n}\\r\\n\\r\\nfunction updatedAt(value: unknown): number {\\r\\n  if (!value || typeof value !== \'object\') return Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;\\r\\n  const timestamp = (value as { updated_at?: unknown }).updated_at;\\r\\n  if (typeof timestamp !== \'string\') return Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;\\r\\n  const parsed = Date.parse(timestamp);\\r\\n  return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;\\r\\n}\\r\\n\\r\\ninterface PendingWrite {\\r\\n  table: string;\\r\\n  id: string;\\r\\n  data: unknown | null; // null = delete\\r\\n}\\r\\n\\r\\nexport class SupabaseSyncedPersistence implements Persistence {\\r\\n  private local: V1Persistence;\\r\\n  private pending = new Map<string, PendingWrite>();\\r\\n  private inFlightWrites = new Map<string, PendingWrite>();\\r\\n  private flushInFlight: Promise<void> | null = null;\\r\\n  private flushTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;\\r\\n  private hydrated = false;\\r\\n  private readyPromise: Promise<void>;\\r\\n\\r\\n  constructor(private userId: string) {\\r\\n    this.local = new V1Persistence(\\r\\n      new LocalStoragePersistence(userId),\\r\\n      new IndexedDBPersistence(userId),\\r\\n    );\\r\\n    // Kick off cloud hydration. The UI does not block on it, but callers that\\r\\n    // must not fabricate a default over real cloud data await ready() first.\\r\\n    // hydrate() never rejects (it catches internally), so ready() always resolves.\\r\\n    this.readyPromise = this.hydrate();\\r\\n\\r\\n    // Best-effort flush on tab close.\\r\\n    if (typeof window !== \'undefined\') {\\r\\n      window.addEventListener(\'beforeunload\', () => {\\r\\n        void this.flush();\\r\\n      });\\r\\n      window.addEventListener(\'visibilitychange\', () => {\\r\\n        if (document.visibilityState === \'hidden\') void this.flush();\\r\\n      });\\r\\n    }\\r\\n  }\\r\\n\\r\\n  ready(): Promise<void> {\\r\\n    return this.readyPromise;\\r\\n  }\\r\\n\\r\\n  private key(table: string, id: string): string {\\r\\n    return `${table}::${id}`;\\r\\n  }\\r\\n\\r\\n  async hydrate(): Promise<void> {\\r\\n    if (this.hydrated || !this.userId || this.userId === \'anon\') return;\\r\\n    try {\\r\\n      const { data, error } = await supabase\\r\\n        .from(\'bootcamp_kv\')\\r\\n        .select(\'table_name, record_id, data\')\\r\\n        .eq(\'user_id\', this.userId);\\r\\n      if (error) {\\r\\n        console.warn(\'[SupabaseSyncedPersistence] hydrate failed\', error.message);\\r\\n        return;\\r\\n      }\\r\\n      for (const row of data ?? clearTimeout(this.flushTimer);\\r\\n    this.flushTimer = setTimeout(() => {\\r\\n      void this.flush();\\r\\n    }, FLUSH_DEBOUNCE_MS);\\r\\n  }\\r\\n\\r\\n  async flush(): Promise<void> {\\r\\n    if (this.flushInFlight) return this.flushInFlight;\\r\\n    if (!this.userId || this.userId === \'anon\') return;\\r\\n    if (this.pending.size === 0) return;\\r\\n    const operation = this.flushPending();\\r\\n    this.flushInFlight = operation;\\r\\n    try {\\r\\n      await operation;\\r\\n    } finally {\\r\\n      this.flushInFlight = null;\\r\\n      if (this.pending.size > 0 && !this.flushTimer) this.scheduleFlush();\\r\\n    }\\r\\n  }\\r\\n\\r\\n  private async flushPending(): Promise<void> {\\r\\n    const batch = Array.from(this.pending.values());\\r\\n    this.pending.clear();\\r\\n    for (const item of batch) this.inFlightWrites.set(this.key(item.table, item.id), item);\\r\\n    if (this.flushTimer) {\\r\\n      clearTimeout(this.flushTimer);\\r\\n FNV-1a 32-bit; collision risk is acceptable since the progress row is\\r\\n  // user-scoped (table key already partitions by user).\\r\\n  let h = 0x811c9dc5;\\r\\n  for (let i = 0; i < userId.length; i++) {\\r\\n    h ^= userId.charCodeAt(i);\\r\\n    h = Math.imul(h, 0x01000193);\\r\\n  }\\r\\n  const hex = (h >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, \'0\');\\r\\n  return []) as FlaggedQuestionRow[];\\r\\n}\\r\\n\\r\\nexport async function updateFlagNote(id: string, note: string): Promise<void> {\\r\\n  // `.select()` matters: an RLS-blocked UPDATE returns success with zero rows\\r\\n  // rather than an error, so without this the UI would report \\"saved\\" for a\\r\\n  // write that never happened.\\r\\n  const { data, error } = await supabase\\r\\n    .from(\'flagged_questions\')\\r\\n    .update({ note: note.trim() ? note : null })\\r\\n    .eq(\'id\', id)\\r\\n    .select(\'id\');\\r\\n  if (error) throw error;\\r\\n  if (!data || data.length === 0) {\\r\\n    throw new Error(\'That note was not saved. You may not have permission to edit this flag.\');\\r\\n  }\\r\\n}\\r\\n\\r\\nexport async function unflag(id: string): Promise<void> {\\r\\n  const { error } = await supabase.from(\'flagged_questions\').delete().eq(\'id\', id);\\r\\n  if (error) throw error;\\r\\n}\\r\\n\\r\\n/**\\r\\n * Puts an unflagged question back. The row gets a fresh id (the original is\\r\\n * gone) but `flagged_at` is preserved, so undo does not silently reorder the\\r\\n * list under the student.\\r\\n */\\r\\nexport async function restoreFlag(\\r\\n  payload: FlagRestorePayload,\\r\\n): Promise<FlaggedQuestionRow> {\\r\\n  const { data, error } = await supabase\\r\\n    .from(\'flagged_questions\')\\r\\n    .insert(payload)\\r\\n    .select()\\r\\n    .single();\\r\\n  if (error) throw error;\\r\\n  return data as FlaggedQuestionRow;\\r\\n}\\r\\n"}'}]

text(await tools.apply_patch("*** Begin Patch\n*** Add File: C:/Users/Joshu/dev/lsatu-connected-experience/src/lib/reviewEpisodes.ts\n+import { supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';\n+\n+export type EpisodeReason = 'missed' | 'teacher_selected';\n+export type EpisodeSource = 'intro_lr_attempts' | 'hs_capstone';\n+export interface ReviewEpisode {\n+  id: string; student_id: string; actor_id: string; source_kind: EpisodeSource;\n+  source_id: string; question_id: string; reason: EpisodeReason; selection_reason: string | null; created_at: string;\n+}\n+export type ReviewEventKind = 'blind_answer' | 'reveal' | 'reflection' | 'complete';\n+export interface ReviewEpisodeEvent {\n+  id: string; episode_id: string; actor_id: string; kind: ReviewEventKind;\n+  payload: Record<string, string>; created_at: string;\n+}\n+export interface EpisodeTransport {\n+  actor(): Promise<string | null>;\n+  rpc(name: string, args: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<{ data: unknown; error: unknown }>;\n+}\n+const defaultTransport: EpisodeTransport = {\n+  async actor() { const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.getUser(); if (error) throw error; return data.user?.id ?? null; },\n+  // Additive RPCs remain unpublished until the separately reviewed artifact is deployed.\n+  rpc: (name, args) => (supabase as unknown as { rpc: EpisodeTransport['rpc'] }).rpc(name, args),\n+};\n+function row(value: unknown): Record<string, unknown> {\n+  if (!value || typeof value !== 'object' || Array.isArray(value)) throw new Error('Review save was not acknowledged.');\n+  return value as Record<string, unknown>;\n+}\n+export function validateReviewEvent(kind: ReviewEventKind, payload: Record<string, string>, reason: EpisodeReason): void {\n+  if (Object.values(payload).some(value => typeof value !== 'string')) throw new Error('Review fields must be text.');\n+  if (kind === 'blind_answer' && !payload.answer?.trim()) throw new Error('Choose a blind answer before saving.');\n+  if (kind === 'complete' && reason === 'missed' && (!payload.error_diagnosis?.trim() || !payload.right_answer_diagnosis?.trim())) {\n+    throw new Error('Explain the error and why the right answer is right before completing this miss.');\n+  }\n+}\n+export function reviewEpisodeState(events: ReviewEpisodeEvent[]) {\n+  const ordered = [...events].sort((a, b) => a.created_at.localeCompare(b.created_at) || a.id.localeCompare(b.id));\n+  return { completed: ordered.some(event => event.kind === 'complete'), revealed: ordered.some(event => event.kind === 'reveal'),\n+    blindAnswer: ordered.find(event => event.kind === 'blind_answer')?.payload.answer ?? null,\n+    reflection: ordered.filter(event => event.kind === 'reflection').at(-1)?.payload.text ?? null };\n+}\n+export function createReviewEpisodeService(transport: EpisodeTransport = defaultTransport) {\n+  async function call(actorId: string, name: string, args: Record<string, unknown>) {\n+    if (await transport.actor() !== actorId) throw new Error('The signed-in account changed.');\n+    const result = await transport.rpc(name, args);\n+    if (result.error) throw result.error;\n+    if (await transport.actor() !== actorId) throw new Error('The signed-in account changed.');\n+    return result.data;\n+  }\n+  return {\n+    async open(input: { actorId: string; studentId: string; source: EpisodeSource; sourceId: string; reason: EpisodeReason; selectionReason?: string }) {\n+      if (input.reason === 'teacher_selected' && !input.selectionReason?.trim()) throw new Error('Give the student a reason for this review.');\n+      const data = row(await call(input.actorId, 'open_review_episode_v1', {\n+        p_student: input.studentId, p_source: input.source, p_source_id: input.sourceId, p_reason: input.reason, p_selection_reason: input.selectionReason?.trim() || null,\n+      }));\n+      if (data.student_id !== input.studentId || data.actor_id !== input.actorId || data.source_kind !== input.source || data.source_id !== input.sourceId || data.reason !== input.reason || typeof data.id !== 'string') throw new Error('Review episode was not acknowledged.');\n+      return data as unknown as ReviewEpisode;\n+    },\n+    async append(actorId: string, episode: ReviewEpisode, id: string, kind: ReviewEventKind, payload: Record<string, string>) {\n+      validateReviewEvent(kind, payload, episode.reason);\n+      const data = row(await call(actorId, 'append_review_event_v1', { p_episode: episode.id, p_event: id, p_kind: kind, p_payload: payload }));\n+      const returned = row(data.payload);\n+      if (data.id !== id || data.episode_id !== episode.id || data.actor_id !== actorId || data.kind !== kind\n+        || Object.keys(returned).length !== Object.keys(payload).length || Object.entries(payload).some(([key, value]) => returned[key] !== value)) throw new Error('Review event was not acknowledged.');\n+      return data as unknown as ReviewEpisodeEvent;\n+    },\n+    async list(actorId: string, studentId: string): Promise<{ episodes: ReviewEpisode[]; events: ReviewEpisodeEvent[] }> {\n+      const data = row(await call(actorId, 'read_review_episodes_v1', { p_student: studentId }));\n+      if (!Array.isArray(data.episodes) || !Array.isArray(data.events) || data.episodes.some(item => row(item).student_id !== studentId)) throw new Error('Review records could not be verified.');\n+      const episodeIds = new Set(data.episodes.map(item => row(item).id));\n+      if (data.events.some(event => !episodeIds.has(row(event).episode_id))) throw new Error('Review event scope could not be verified.');\n+      return data as unknown as { episodes: ReviewEpisode[]; events: ReviewEpisodeEvent[] };\n+    },\n+  };\n+}\n*** End Patch"));

text(await tools.apply_patch("*** Begin Patch\n*** Add File: C:/Users/Joshu/dev/lsatu-connected-experience/docs/implementation-plans/artifacts/2026-09-30-review-episodes.sql\n+-- Unapplied additive contract. No source attempt, flag, journal or note writes.\n+BEGIN;\n+SET LOCAL lock_timeout = '3s';\n+SET LOCAL statement_timeout = '45s';\n+CREATE TABLE public.review_episodes_v1 (\n+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),\n+  student_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id),\n+  actor_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id),\n+  source_kind text NOT NULL CHECK (source_kind IN ('intro_lr_attempts','hs_capstone')),\n+  source_id text NOT NULL, question_id text NOT NULL,\n+  reason text NOT NULL CHECK (reason IN ('missed','teacher_selected')),\n+  selection_reason text,\n+  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(),\n+  CHECK (reason <> 'teacher_selected' OR length(btrim(selection_reason)) > 0 AND selection_reason IS NOT NULL),\n+  UNIQUE(student_id, source_kind, source_id, reason, actor_id)\n+);\n+CREATE TABLE public.review_episode_events_v1 (\n+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY, episode_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.review_episodes_v1(id),\n+  actor_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id),\n+  kind text NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('blind_answer','reveal','reflection','complete')),\n+  payload jsonb NOT NULL CHECK (jsonb_typeof(payload) = 'object'),\n+  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp()\n+);\n+CREATE INDEX review_episode_student_v1 ON public.review_episodes_v1(student_id,created_at);\n+CREATE INDEX review_episode_event_v1 ON public.review_episode_events_v1(episode_id,created_at);\n+ALTER TABLE public.review_episodes_v1 ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;\n+ALTER TABLE public.review_episode_events_v1 ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;\n+CREATE POLICY review_episode_read_v1 ON public.review_episodes_v1 FOR SELECT TO authenticated\n+USING (student_id = auth.uid() OR public.has_role(auth.uid(),'admin'));\n+CREATE POLICY review_event_read_v1 ON public.review_episode_events_v1 FOR SELECT TO authenticated\n+USING (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.review_episodes_v1 e WHERE e.id=episode_id AND (e.student_id=auth.uid() OR public.has_role(auth.uid(),'admin'))));\n+REVOKE ALL ON public.review_episodes_v1,public.review_episode_events_v1 FROM PUBLIC,anon,authenticated;\n+GRANT SELECT ON public.review_episodes_v1,public.review_episode_events_v1 TO authenticated;\n+\n+CREATE FUNCTION public.open_review_episode_v1(p_student uuid,p_source text,p_source_id text,p_reason text,p_selection_reason text DEFAULT NULL)\n+RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=pg_catalog,public AS $$\n+DECLARE actor uuid:=auth.uid(); q text; correct boolean; existing public.review_episodes_v1%ROWTYPE;\n+BEGIN\n+  IF actor IS NULL OR p_student IS NULL OR p_reason NOT IN ('missed','teacher_selected') OR p_reason IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid review actor or reason'; END IF;\n+  IF p_reason='teacher_selected' THEN\n+    IF NOT public.has_role(actor,'admin') OR actor=p_student OR p_selection_reason IS NULL OR length(btrim(p_selection_reason))=0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Teacher selection requires admin access and a reason'; END IF;\n+  ELSIF actor<>p_student THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Only the student may open a missed episode'; END IF;\n+  IF p_source='intro_lr_attempts' THEN\n+    SELECT a.question_id,a.correct INTO q,correct FROM public.intro_lr_attempts a WHERE a.user_id=p_student AND a.id::text=p_source_id FOR SHARE;\n+  ELSIF p_source='hs_capstone' THEN\n+    SELECT k.data->>'item_id',(k.data->>'correct')::boolean INTO q,correct FROM public.bootcamp_kv k\n+    WHERE k.user_id=p_student AND k.table_name='calibration_attempts' AND k.record_id=p_source_id\n+      AND k.data->>'user_id'=p_student::text AND k.data->>'calibration_module'='M5' AND k.data->'calibration_only'='true'::jsonb FOR SHARE;\n+  ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION 'Unsupported review source'; END IF;\n+  IF q IS NULL OR correct IS NULL OR (p_reason='missed' AND correct) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Owned source does not support this review reason'; END IF;\n+  INSERT INTO public.review_episodes_v1(student_id,actor_id,source_kind,source_id,question_id,reason,selection_reason)\n+    VALUES(p_student,actor,p_source,p_source_id,q,p_reason,CASE WHEN p_reason='teacher_selected' THEN btrim(p_selection_reason) ELSE NULL END)\n+    ON CONFLICT(student_id,source_kind,source_id,reason,actor_id) DO NOTHING;\n+  SELECT * INTO existing FROM public.review_episodes_v1 WHERE student_id=p_student AND actor_id=actor AND source_kind=p_source AND source_id=p_source_id AND reason=p_reason;\n+  IF p_reason='teacher_selected' AND existing.selection_reason<>btrim(p_selection_reason) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Existing selection has a different reason'; END IF;\n+  RETURN to_jsonb(existing);\n+END $$;\n+\n+CREATE FUNCTION public.append_review_event_v1(p_episode uuid,p_event uuid,p_kind text,p_payload jsonb)\n+RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=pg_catalog,public AS $$\n+DECLARE actor uuid:=auth.uid(); episode public.review_episodes_v1%ROWTYPE; prior public.review_episode_events_v1%ROWTYPE; saved public.review_episode_events_v1%ROWTYPE;\n+BEGIN\n+  SELECT * INTO episode FROM public.review_episodes_v1 WHERE id=p_episode FOR UPDATE;\n+  IF actor IS NULL OR episode.id IS NULL OR actor<>episode.student_id THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Only the student may record review work'; END IF;\n+  SELECT * INTO prior FROM public.review_episode_events_v1 WHERE id=p_event;\n+  IF prior.id IS NOT NULL THEN\n+    IF prior.episode_id<>p_episode OR prior.actor_id<>actor OR prior.kind IS DISTINCT FROM p_kind OR prior.payload IS DISTINCT FROM p_payload THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Review event identity conflict'; END IF;\n+    RETURN to_jsonb(prior);\n+  END IF;\n+  IF p_event IS NULL OR p_kind IS NULL OR p_kind NOT IN ('blind_answer','reveal','reflection','complete') OR p_payload IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(p_payload)<>'object'\n+    OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_each(p_payload) v WHERE jsonb_typeof(v.value)<>'string') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid review event'; END IF;\n+  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.review_episode_events_v1 WHERE episode_id=p_episode AND kind='complete') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'This review episode is complete'; END IF;\n+  IF p_kind='blind_answer' THEN\n+    IF coalesce(length(btrim(p_payload->>'answer')),0)=0 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.review_episode_events_v1 WHERE episode_id=p_episode AND kind IN ('blind_answer','reveal')) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Blind answer must precede reveal and is immutable'; END IF;\n+  END IF;\n+  IF p_kind='reveal' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.review_episode_events_v1 WHERE episode_id=p_episode AND kind='reveal') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Reveal already recorded'; END IF;\n+  IF p_kind='complete' AND episode.reason='missed' AND (coalesce(length(btrim(p_payload->>'error_diagnosis')),0)=0 OR coalesce(length(btrim(p_payload->>'right_answer_diagnosis')),0)=0) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Miss completion requires error and right-answer diagnoses'; END IF;\n+  INSERT INTO public.review_episode_events_v1(id,episode_id,actor_id,kind,payload) VALUES(p_event,p_episode,actor,p_kind,p_payload) RETURNING * INTO saved;\n+  RETURN to_jsonb(saved);\n+END $$;\n+\n+CREATE FUNCTION public.read_review_episodes_v1(p_student uuid)\n+RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=pg_catalog,public AS $$\n+BEGIN\n+  IF auth.uid() IS NULL OR p_student IS NULL OR (auth.uid()<>p_student AND NOT public.has_role(auth.uid(),'admin')) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Review access denied'; END IF;\n+  RETURN jsonb_build_object('episodes',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(e) ORDER BY e.created_at,e.id) FROM public.review_episodes_v1 e WHERE e.student_id=p_student),'[]'::jsonb),\n+    'events',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(v) ORDER BY v.created_at,v.id) FROM public.review_episode_events_v1 v JOIN public.review_episodes_v1 e ON e.id=v.episode_id WHERE e.student_id=p_student),'[]'::jsonb));\n+END $$;\n+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.open_review_episode_v1(uuid,text,text,text,text),public.append_review_event_v1(uuid,uuid,text,jsonb),public.read_review_episodes_v1(uuid) FROM PUBLIC,anon;\n+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.open_review_episode_v1(uuid,text,text,text,text),public.append_review_event_v1(uuid,uuid,text,jsonb),public.read_review_episodes_v1(uuid) TO authenticated;\n+COMMIT;\n*** End Patch"));

'vitest';\n+vi.mock('@/integrations/supabase/client', () => ({ supabase: {} }));\n+import { createReviewEpisodeService, reviewEpisodeState, validateReviewEvent, type ReviewEpisode, type ReviewEpisodeEvent } from './reviewEpisodes';\n+const episode: ReviewEpisode = { id: 'episode', student_id: 'student', actor_id: 'student', source_kind: 'intro_lr_attempts', source_id: 'attempt', question_id: 'question', reason: 'missed', selection_reason: null, created_at: '2026-09-30T12:00:00Z' };\n+const event = (kind: ReviewEpisodeEvent['kind'], payload: Record<string, string> = {}): ReviewEpisodeEvent => ({ id: kind, episode_id: episode.id, actor_id: 'student', kind, payload, created_at: '2026-09-30T12:01:00Z' });\n+describe('durable review episode contract', () => {\n+  it('requires both diagnoses only for missed completion', () => {\n+    expect(() => validateReviewEvent('complete', {}, 'missed')).toThrow('right answer');\n+    expect(() => validateReviewEvent('complete', { error_diagnosis: 'scope', right_answer_diagnosis: 'matches conclusion' }, 'missed')).not.toThrow();\n+    expect(() => validateReviewEvent('complete', {}, 'teacher_selected')).not.toThrow();\n+  });\n+  it('completion changes episode state without changing supplied attempt or flag records', () => {\n+    const source = { answer: 'A', flagged: true }; const before = structuredClone(source);\n+    expect(reviewEpisodeState([event('blind_answer', { answer: 'B' }), event('complete')])).toEqual({ completed: true, revealed: false, blindAnswer: 'B', reflection: null });\n+    expect(source).toEqual(before);\n+    expect(reviewEpisodeState([]).completed).toBe(false);\n+  });\n+  it('retains response identity for retries and rejects zero-row acknowledgement', async () => {\n+    const rpc = vi.fn().mockResolvedValueOnce({ data: null, error: new Error('offline') }).mockResolvedValueOnce({ data: event('reveal'), error: null });\n+    const service = createReviewEpisodeService({ actor: async () => 'student', rpc });\n+    await expect(service.append('student', episode, 'reveal', 'reveal', {})).rejects.toThrow('offline');\n+    await expect(service.append('student', episode, 'reveal', 'reveal', {})).resolves.toMatchObject({ id: 'reveal' });\n+    expect(rpc.mock.calls[0][1]).toEqual(rpc.mock.calls[1][1]);\n+ ## assistant

Finished bounded teacher selection and student queue integration.

- Teacher selects an actual owned native/HS miss with a required, acknowledged reason.
- Student sees the exact episode link and teacher reason.
- Completed tasks leave the active queue; flags, original attempts and later attempts remain.
- Failed saves retain the reason and support retry or safe reload recovery.

**57 integrated tests passed, typecheck passed, ESLint passed.** No App edits. Broader #170 coverage remains open; root owns browser verification and release.

no table policy is broadened.\\r\\nBEGIN;\\r\\nSET LOCAL lock_timeout = \'3s\';\\r\\nSET LOCAL statement_timeout = \'30s\';\\r\\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_student_progress_user_id(p_class_id text)\\r\\nRETURNS uuid\\r\\nLANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\\r\\nSET search_path = pg_catalog, public\\r\\nAS $function$\\r\\nDECLARE\\r\\n  v_actor uuid := auth.uid();\\r\\n  v_owner uuid;\\r\\nBEGIN\\r\\n  IF v_actor IS NULL THEN\\r\\n    RAISE EXCEPTION \'Authentication required\' USING ERRCODE = \'42501\';\\r\\n  END IF;\\r\\n  IF NOT public.has_role(v_actor, \'admin\'::public.app_role) THEN\\r\\n    SELECT s.user_id INTO v_owner FROM public.students s\\r\\n      WHERE s.class_id = p_class_id AND s.user_id = v_actor;\\r\\n    IF v_owner IS NULL THEN\\r\\n      RAISE EXCEPTION \'Student account access denied\' USING ERRCODE = \'42501\';\\r\\n    END IF;\\r\\n    IF v_owner::text IS DISTINCT FROM p_class_id THEN\\r\\n      RAISE EXCEPTION \'Student identity mapping conflicts with canonical account\' USING ERRCODE = \'42501\';\\r\\n    END IF;\\r\\n    RETURN v_owner;\\r\\n  END IF;\\r\\n  SELECT s.user_id INTO STRICT v_owner FROM public.students s WHERE s.class_id = p_class_id;\\r\\n  IF v_owner::text IS DISTINCT FROM p_class_id THEN\\r\\n    RAISE EXCEPTION \'Student identity mapping conflicts with canonical account\' USING ERRCODE = \'42501\';\\r\\n  END IF;\\r\\n  RETURN v_owner;\\r\\nEXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN\\r\\n  RETURN NULL;\\r\\nEND;\\r\\n$function$;\\r\\nREVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.get_student_progress_user_id(text) FROM PUBLIC, anon;\\r\\nGRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.get_student_progress_user_id(text) TO authenticated;\\r\\nCOMMIT;\\r\\n{\\"body\\":\\"Part of implementation spec #165. Decision source: #155. Release order 8/13.\\\\n\\\\n## Outcome\\\\nProgress and teacher Insights use one student-scoped attempt ledger, one first-answer calculation, and transparent evidence.\\\\n## Build\\\\n- Page through eligible LR/RC attempts with typed source and mode. Select the first saved graded answer ever per distinct question, then apply the selected 7/14/21/30/All window to that first answer\'s date. A repeat inside the window is never eligible when its first answer predates the window. Full-test and timed-section answers enter only after saved finish/submission makes them graded. Retain repeats in History and volume.\\\\n- Exclude Inspect, blind answers, and ungraded work. Keep LR/RC separate. Show numerator, denominator, source coverage, missing sources, and insufficient evidence below three questions; label three to nine as an early signal.\\\\n- Add History filters and Topics priorities with evidence and direct Review or prefilled drill actions. Attribute assignments only from stored links.\\\\n## Acceptance\\\\n- [ ] Each displayed numerator/denominator traces to eligible attempt IDs and changes with timeframe.\\\\n- [ ] Repeats change History/volume without rewriting first-answer accuracy.\\\\n- [ ] Student and selected-student teacher views match for the same window.\\\\n- [ ] Missing coverage, sparse evidence, and unsupported sources are clearly labeled.\\\\n## Verification\\\\nReducer tests with LR/RC/first/repeat/blind/Inspect fixtures and live source reconciliation for sample students.\\\\n\\\\r\\\\n\\\\r\\\\n\\\\r\\\\n\\\\n## Audit detail added 2026-09-28\\\\n- Provide an optional dense, sortable History table with date, source, mode, PT/section/question, result, first/blind answer, time, flag, notes, assignment link, and review state. Query-backed filters include question type, reasoning, feature, difficulty, source, and date where those taxonomies are reliable.\\\\n- Make source coverage and filter limits explicit; a filtered table must not silently use a different attempt population from the overview.\\\\r\\\\n\\"}\\n"}'}]

text(await tools.apply_patch("*** Begin Patch\n*** Add File: C:/Users/Joshu/dev/lsatu-connected-experience/docs/agent/verification/2026-09-30-progress-history-audit.md\n+# Progress and History account parity\n+\n+Read-only exploration followed by the authorized canonical identity correction. No source records, identity mappings, RLS policies or backend functions were changed by this batch.\n+\n+## Verified calculations and source populations\n+\n+- First-answer calculation selects the first graded response globally before applying 7/14/21/30/All. Repeats in the window do not rewrite an earlier first answer. Percentages remain unavailable below three distinct questions; three to nine is an early signal.\n+- Completed protected LR sections enter via `section_history` question detail. Their `attempts.mode='full-section'` rows are excluded from the ordinary drill adapter, preventing double counting. Unanswered questions do not enter answer accuracy.\n+- Completed RC sessions gate RC first-answer eligibility. The reader now preserves `timed_section_sitting_id` and labels those owned standalone sources `timed-section`; ordinary drills remain `rc-drill`, completed PrepTests remain `practice-test`.\n+- The canonical selected-student RPC deliberately rejects distinct class/auth UUIDs. The corrected readers validate the canonical account before querying account records, retain the original class scope for permission checks, and fail visibly on missing/conflicting identity. Self account reads retain their UUID.\n+- Ordinary tester/admin JWT source reconciliation matched row counts and SHA256 values for all five ledger sources: attempts 17, section_history 9, rc_attempts 81, rc_drill_sessions 11, practice_test_runs 2. This establishes matching raw source populations for one designated QA account, not every account or browser rendering. Evidence: `2026-09-30-first-answer-source-parity-live.json`.\n+\n+## Remaining concrete History work\n+\n+1. `src/pages/DrillHistory.tsx` catches a section query failure and sets `sections=[]`. It consequently presents an empty Sections list instead of unavailable data. Test: reject section read while ordinary attempt read succeeds; retain available attempts and show section retry/error rather than “no sections.”\n+2. The same page stores rows/sections without owner scope and does not reset them when auth owner changes. Test: load owner A, switch to B while B queries remain pending; A's rows/counts must disappear immediately, and late A responses must not populate B.\n+3. Sections are all time while Timeline/By question follow the window. The page explicitly discloses “Sections below show all time,” so this is a known product scope distinction rather than silent filtering. Shared-window section behavior remains a #173 acceptance decision.\n+4. Tracked `drill_history` RC SQL directly selects `rc_attempts.is_correct` without joining session completion. Protected RC checkpoints persist grading before close. The legacy History timeline can therefore reveal an active end-of-set outcome unless its live source is masked. Root assigned navigation review/fix before release; this audit makes no claim that the managed view was independently inspected or the fix completed.\n+\n+Meaningful outcome masking check: an actual owned protected in-progress RC session with saved responses must remain unfinished/ungraded in History, then become graded after acknowledged completion. Existing completed RC outcomes and original source rows must remain unchanged. A query failure must fail visibly rather than imply complete coverage.\n+\n+#173 remains open for broader coverage, dense table/source-linked actions and full live acceptance. #170 remains open outside the bounded native/Hard Sentences episode implementation.\n*** End Patch"));

## assistant

Found five actionable source-level gaps:

- Authenticated users can invoke coaching without entitlement checks, usage limits or request idempotency.
- Activity grading trusts caller-supplied answer keys and system rubric instructions.
- Invalid model verdicts silently become “incorrect.”
- Students can repeatedly force expensive section regrading.
- Error logs can retain model output containing student responses or answer keys.

The internal Gemini proxy correctly rejects requests without its shared secret. No AI calls, credits or backend writes used; deployed behavior remains to be verified.

[{'type': 'input_text', 'text': 'Script completed\nWall time 0.6 seconds\nOutput:\n'}, {'type': 'input_text', 'text': '{"chunk_id":"34b2fb","wall_time_seconds":0.3975239,"exit_code":0,"original_token_count":1227,"output":"-- A run is graded once, and an abandoned one never.\\r\\n--\\r\\n-- Two things the 2026-09-03 student-run audit found on the ordinary path.\\r\\n--\\r\\n-- 1. The grader ran twice on every run. The Report Card asks again twenty\\r\\n--    seconds after the runner\'s own ask, the first grading takes a minute or\\r\\n--    more, and nothing on record said one was in flight -- so both transcribed,\\r\\n--    both judged, and the card she read was overwritten by a second verdict on\\r\\n--    the same audio. The grader now claims an Attempt here before it starts and\\r\\n--    releases it when it ends. A claim that was never released expires, so a\\r\\n--    grader that died mid-run cannot hold its Attempt hostage.\\r\\n--\\r\\n-- 2. Starting a section again from the library marked the abandoned run as\\r\\n--    completed, and a completed run with rows is exactly what the grader and\\r\\n--    the sweeper grade. A run abandoned at stimulus 3 came back as a Report\\r\\n--    Card reading \\"0%, 2 stimuli, inside the time\\". ADR 0023 says an abandoned\\r\\n--    run is never graded; it now has a status that says so.\\r\\n\\r\\n-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\\r\\n-- 1. The claim.\\r\\n-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\\r\\n\\r\\ncreate table if not exists public.activity_section_grading_claims (\\r\\n  assignment_id uuid not null references public.activity_assignments(id) on delete cascade,\\r\\n  attempt_no smallint not null,\\r\\n  claimed_at timestamptz not null default now(),\\r\\n  primary key (assignment_id, attempt_no)\\r\\n);\\r\\n\\r\\ncomment on table public.activity_section_grading_claims is\\r\\n  \'One row per Attempt whose grading is in flight. Written by the grader before it transcribes, removed when it finishes, and ignored once stale. make_interval(secs => p_stale_seconds)\\r\\n  returning true into v_taken;\\r\\n  return coalesce(v_taken, false);\\r\\nend;\\r\\n$fn$;\\r\\n\\r\\ncreate or replace function public.release_section_grading(\\r\\n  p_assignment_id uuid,\\r\\n  p_attempt_no integer\\r\\n)\\r\\nreturns void\\r\\nlanguage sql\\r\\nsecurity definer\\r\\nset search_path = public\\r\\nas $fn$\\r\\n  delete from public.activity_section_grading_claims\\r\\n   where assignment_id = p_assignment_id and attempt_no = p_attempt_no;\\r\\n$fn$;\\r\\n\\r\\nrevoke all on function public.claim_section_grading(uuid, integer, integer) from public, anon, authenticated;\\r\\nrevoke all on function public.release_section_grading(uuid, integer) from public, anon, authenticated;\\r\\ngrant execute on function public.claim_section_grading(uuid, integer, integer) to service_role;\\r\\ngrant execute on function public.release_section_grading(uuid, integer) to service_role;\\r\\n\\r\\n-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\\r\\n-- 2. Two blocking SQL/Edge mismatches:

- Dispatch replies omit the payload that the Edge function immediately reads.
